title: Pocorn yard, a killing, and street guitarists
summary: He recalls dances at Pocorn yard where a guitarist named Hamp was killed, and guitarists who played fish fries and serenaded the streets for nickels and dimes.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: They have a lot of guys that just play piano and guitar and all kind of odd instruments serenading like that.

Yeah. Well that's all they did then. You see a fellow at two or three o'clock in the morning you'd hear a fellow passing the street playing his guitar, the blues, and a fellow people throwing nickels, dimes, you know, in that hole in there. And that's how they did. That's how they hustle.
